description: Creates a new secondary Google Calendar with the specified title and optional settings. Use this action when you need to create a new calendar for organizing events separately from the primary calendar. The authenticated user becomes the owner of the newly created calendar. Optional parameters include description, location, and timezone.

description.description: Description of the calendar. Provides additional context about the calendar's purpose.
examples: Calendar for tracking team events and meetings
description.title: Description

location.description: Geographic location of the calendar as free-form text.
location.title: Location

summary.description: Title of the calendar. This is the name that will be displayed in Google Calendar.
summary.title: Summary

timezone.description: The time zone of the calendar, specified as an IANA Time Zone Database name (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Tokyo'). If not specified, defaults to UTC.
timezone.title: Timezone

name: create_calendar

allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.description: The types of conference solutions supported for this calendar.
allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.title: Allowed Conference Solution Types

dataOwner.description: Email address of the calendar's owner.
dataOwner.title: Data Owner

display_url.description: Direct URL to the calendar's settings page in the Google Calendar web interface.
display_url.title: Display Url

etag.description: ETag of the resource. Used for caching and concurrency control.
etag.title: Etag

id.description: Identifier of the calendar, typically an email-like value.
id.title: Id

location.description: Geographic location of the calendar as free-form text.
location.title: Location

timeZone.description: The time zone of the calendar, specified as an IANA Time Zone Database name.
timeZone.title: Time Zone
